def process(load_csn_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_csn_data.copy()
    # Remove empty rows and metadata rows
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    # Skip header row (index 0) and source row
    df = df[df['Unnamed: 0'] != 'Source: Consumer Sentinel Network Data Book 2024, Federal Trade Commission'].copy()
    df = df[df['Unnamed: 0'] != 'Year'].copy()
    # Rename columns
    df.columns = ['Year', 'Fraud', 'Identity_Theft', 'Other']
    # Convert to numeric, removing commas
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df['Fraud'] = df['Fraud'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df['Identity_Theft'] = df['Identity_Theft'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df['Other'] = df['Other'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    # Drop rows with NaN years
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Year'])
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
    return df
